Santa Fe Seniors on Bikes Tuesday Ride

Santa Fe, NM · Road

Santa Fe Seniors on Bikes Tuesday Ride is a road group ride in Santa Fe, NM. It rolls every Tuesday at 9:00 am from DeVargas Mall. Pace: a (energetic) and B (relaxed) groups.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: a (energetic) and B (relaxed) groups. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Santa Fe Seniors on Bikes Tuesday Ride group ride

A social road ride for riders 50 and older, split into an energetic A group and a relaxed B group. Rides cancel automatically in freezing, hot, wet or windy weather. The club also rides Thursdays (April–October) and Saturdays.
